title: Local continuous choice of coherent realizations

blocks.tex:
The coherent converse has a local parameter-dependent strengthening.
Fix a positive nonconstant admissible profile $\kappa_0\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$,
with $n\ge4$. On an open neighborhood of $\kappa_0$ in $\RR^n$, one can
choose coherent realizing polygons whose labelled vertices depend $C^1$
on the prescribed curvature vector. The topology on the output is the
ordinary topology of $\CC^n$, without quotienting by rigid motions or
changing the labels. Repeated readings and constant runs are allowed.
The constant-profile disjunct of the existence theorem is not covered here.

The key is to fix one regular four-edge anchor at the base profile. Its
selection need not vary continuously. A parametric correction, supported
on the positive edges of this fixed anchor, opens all dormant lengths and
then realizes every nearby profile while preserving the strict walls.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_parametric_correction
blocks.title: Parametric constraint correction
blocks.body:
Let $P,E,F$ be real Banach spaces, let $f\colon P\times E\to F$ be $C^1$
near $(p_0,x_0)$, and suppose $R\colon F\to E$ is a continuous linear
right inverse of $D_xf(p_0,x_0)$. There is a local $C^1$ correction
$Q(p,x)$ with $Q(p_0,x_0)=x_0$ such that
\[
 Q(p,x)-x\in\operatorname{range}R,\qquad
 f(p,Q(p,x))=f(p_0,x_0).
\]
The correction fixes nearby points already on this level.

lean.name: ContDiffAt.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection
lean.code:
theorem ContDiffAt.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection
    {n : ℕ∞ω} {f : P × E → F} {p₀ : P} {x₀ : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (p₀, x₀)) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (R : F →L[ℝ] E)
    (hR : (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P E) ∘L R =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) :
    ∃ Q : P × E → E,
      ContDiffAt ℝ n Q (p₀, x₀) ∧ Q (p₀, x₀) = x₀ ∧
      (∀ q, Q q - q.2 ∈ R.range) ∧
      (∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), f (q.1, Q q) = f (p₀, x₀)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), f q = f (p₀, x₀) → Q q = q.2) := by
  let L : (P × E) × F →L[ℝ] P × E :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (P × E) F +
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P E ∘L R ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (P × E) F
  have hL : ∀ q a, L (q, a) = (q.1, q.2 + R a) := by
    intro q a
    ext <;> simp [L]
  have hL₀ : L ((p₀, x₀), 0) = (p₀, x₀) := by simp [hL]
  have hG : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) := by
    exact (hL₀ ▸ hf).comp _ L.contDiff.contDiffAt
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) =
      fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L L := by
    have hf' : HasStrictFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀)) (L ((p₀, x₀), 0)) := by
      simpa only [hL₀] using hf.hasStrictFDerivAt hn
    have h := hf'.comp ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F))
      L.hasStrictFDerivAt
    exact h.hasFDerivAt.fderiv
  have hinr : (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L L) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × E) F = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    rw [← hR]
    ext a
    simp [L]
  have hinv : (fderiv ℝ (fun v => f (L v)) ((p₀, x₀), (0 : F)) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × E) F).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hd, hinr]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ F, rfl⟩
  let ψ := hG.implicitFunction hn hinv
  have hψ₀ : ψ (p₀, x₀) = 0 := hG.implicitFunction_apply_self hn hinv
  have hψcd : ContDiffAt ℝ n ψ (p₀, x₀) := hG.contDiffAt_implicitFunction hn hinv
  refine ⟨fun q => q.2 + R (ψ q), contDiffAt_snd.add (R.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp _ hψcd),
    by simp [hψ₀], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    exact ⟨ψ q, by simp⟩
  · filter_upwards [hG.eventually_apply_implicitFunction hn hinv] with q hq
    change f (L (q, ψ q)) = f (L ((p₀, x₀), 0)) at hq
    rw [hL, hL₀] at hq
    exact hq
  · have ht : Tendsto (fun q : P × E => (q, (0 : F)))
        (𝓝 (p₀, x₀)) (𝓝 ((p₀, x₀), 0)) := continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const
    have he := ht.eventually (hG.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction hn hinv)
    filter_upwards [he] with q hq
    intro hsol
    have hz : ψ q = 0 := hq.mp (by simpa [hL] using hsol)
    simp [hz]

end

blocks.tex:
Apply the implicit function theorem to
$f(p,x+Ra)=f(p_0,x_0)$ with unknown $a\in F$. Its derivative in $a$ at
$((p_0,x_0),0)$ is the identity. The implicit solution $a=\psi(p,x)$ gives
$Q(p,x)=x+R\psi(p,x)$. Local uniqueness gives the fixed-point assertion.

blocks.label: thm:discrete_positive_section
blocks.title: Positive sections from active-supported surjectivity
blocks.body:
Let $P$ be a real Banach space and $F$ a finite-dimensional real normed
space. Suppose $f\colon P\times\RR^N\to F$ is $C^1$ near $(p_0,x_0)$,
where every coordinate of $x_0$ is nonnegative. Suppose that for every
$y\in F$ there is $b\in\RR^N$ with
\[
 D_x f(p_0,x_0)b=y,\qquad b_i=0\text{ whenever }(x_0)_i=0.
\]
For every open set $V\subseteq P\times\RR^N$ containing $(p_0,x_0)$,
there is an open neighborhood $U$ of $p_0$ and a $C^1$ map
$s\colon U\to\RR^N$ such that, for all $p\in U$,
\[
 (p,s(p))\in V,\qquad s_i(p)>0\ (1\le i\le N),\qquad
 f(p,s(p))=f(p_0,x_0).
\]
No equality $s(p_0)=x_0$ is asserted when $x_0$ has zero coordinates.

lean.name: ContDiffAt.exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
lean.code:
theorem ContDiffAt.exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
    {f : P × (ι → ℝ) → F} {p₀ : P} {x₀ : ι → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f (p₀, x₀)) (hx₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x₀ i)
    (hactive : ∀ y : F, ∃ b : ι → ℝ,
      (fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P (ι → ℝ)) b = y ∧
        ∀ i, x₀ i = 0 → b i = 0)
    {V : Set (P × (ι → ℝ))} (hV : IsOpen V) (hV₀ : (p₀, x₀) ∈ V) :
    ∃ (U : Set P) (s : P → (ι → ℝ)), IsOpen U ∧ p₀ ∈ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 s U ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, (p, s p) ∈ V ∧ (∀ i, 0 < s p i) ∧ f (p, s p) = f (p₀, x₀) := by
  classical
  have : CompleteSpace F := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ F
  let D : Submodule ℝ (ι → ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {b | ∀ i, x₀ i = 0 → b i = 0}
      zero_mem' := by simp
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb i hi; simp [ha i hi, hb i hi]
      smul_mem' := by intro c b hb i hi; simp [hb i hi] }
  let A := fderiv ℝ f (p₀, x₀) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P (ι → ℝ)
  let B : D →L[ℝ] F := A ∘L D.subtypeL
  have hB : B.range = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    intro y
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbs⟩ := hactive y
    exact ⟨⟨b, hbs⟩, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := B.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective hB
  let R : F →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) := D.subtypeL ∘L g
  have hR : A ∘L R = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    rw [show A ∘L R = B ∘L g from rfl]
    exact hg
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcd, hQ₀, hQrange, hQeq, -⟩ :=
    hf.exists_parametricConstraintCorrection one_ne_zero R hR
  have hfixed : ∀ q i, x₀ i = 0 → Q q i = q.2 i := by
    intro q i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hQrange q
    have hz : (R a) i = 0 := (g a).property i hi
    have hai : R a i = Q q i - q.2 i := congrFun ha i
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hai.symm.trans hz)
  have hQpair : ContinuousAt (fun q : P × (ι → ℝ) => (q.1, Q q)) (p₀, x₀) :=
    continuousAt_fst.prodMk hQcd.continuousAt
  have hQV : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), (q.1, Q q) ∈ V := by
    apply hQpair.preimage_mem_nhds
    simpa [hQ₀] using hV.mem_nhds hV₀
  have hQpos : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), ∀ i, x₀ i ≠ 0 → 0 < Q q i := by
    apply eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    by_cases hi : x₀ i = 0
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (by simp [hi])
    · have hp : 0 < Q (p₀, x₀) i := by rw [hQ₀]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hx₀ i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have hc := (continuous_apply i).continuousAt.comp hQcd.continuousAt
      exact (hc.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hp)).mono (fun _ h _ => h)
  have hgood : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p₀, x₀), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Q q ∧
      (q.1, Q q) ∈ V ∧ (∀ i, x₀ i ≠ 0 → 0 < Q q i) ∧
        f (q.1, Q q) = f (p₀, x₀) := by
    filter_upwards [hQcd.eventually (by norm_num), hQV, hQpos, hQeq] with q h1 h2 h3 h4
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hWgood, hWopen, hW₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  let d : ι → ℝ := fun i => if x₀ i = 0 then 1 else 0
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (p₀, x₀ + t • d)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (p₀, x₀)) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (p₀, x₀ + t • d)) := by fun_prop
    simpa using hc.tendsto 0
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.tex:
Let $D$ be the linear subspace of vectors vanishing on the zero coordinates
of $x_0$. The restriction $D_xf(p_0,x_0)|_D$ is onto. Since $F$ is finite
dimensional, choose a continuous linear right inverse $R$ taking values in
$D$. Apply \cref{lem:discrete_parametric_correction} with this $R$.

Let $d_i=1$ on the zero coordinates of $x_0$ and $d_i=0$ elsewhere.
Because $Q(p,x)-x\in D$, the zero-coordinate readouts of
$Q(p,x_0+\varepsilon d)$ are exactly $\varepsilon$, for every $p$.
At the other coordinates $Q(p_0,x_0)=x_0$ is strictly positive.
Continuity and the openness of $V$ therefore allow a fixed sufficiently
small $\varepsilon>0$ for which $Q(p_0,x_0+\varepsilon d)$ is positive
and lies in $V$ with its parameter. Choose the neighborhood small enough
that the correction equation, these inequalities, and the $C^1$ property
all hold. Taking its slice at $x_0+\varepsilon d$ gives the desired
$s(p)=Q(p,x_0+\varepsilon d)$ on an open neighborhood of $p_0$.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_joint_smoothness
blocks.title: Joint smoothness inside the strict walls
blocks.body:
The turning angles, headings, labelled vertices and closure controller
\[
 G(\kappa,\ell)=(E(\kappa,\ell),T(\kappa,\ell)-2\pi)
\]
are smooth jointly in the curvature and length vectors whenever
$|\kappa_i\ell_{i-1}/2|<1$ and $|\kappa_i\ell_i/2|<1$ at every index.
Zero lengths are permitted in this assertion. The length partial
derivative of $G$ equals the derivative of the native length-only map.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r closureMapR3 (κ, ℓ) := by
  have ht : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      turningSum p.1 p.2) (κ, ℓ) := by
    unfold turningSum
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint _ (hw i).1 (hw i).2
  exact (contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint n hw).prodMk (ht.sub contDiffAt_const)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint (i : ZMod n)
    (hw₁ : |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1)
    (hw₂ : |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      turningAngle 0 p.1 p.2 i) (κ, ℓ) := by
  rw [abs_lt] at hw₁ hw₂
  have h₁ : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2))
      (κ, ℓ) := by fun_prop
  have h₂ : ContDiffAt ℝ r
      (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2))
      (κ, ℓ) := by fun_prop
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, turningAngle, tK_zero] using
    ((Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw₁.1) (ne_of_lt hw₁.2)).comp (κ, ℓ) h₁).add
      ((Real.contDiffAt_arcsin (ne_of_gt hw₂.1) (ne_of_lt hw₂.2)).comp (κ, ℓ) h₂)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fderiv_closureMapR3_inr
lean.code:
theorem fderiv_closureMapR3_inr
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    fderiv ℝ closureMapR3 (κ, ℓ) ∘L
        ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun L => closureMapR3 (κ, L)) ℓ := by
  have hf := (contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint (r := 1) hw).hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero
  have hi : HasFDerivAt (fun L : ZMod n → ℝ => (κ, L))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ)) ℓ := by
    rw [show ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ) (ZMod n → ℝ) =
        (0 : (ZMod n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ZMod n → ℝ)).prod
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ZMod n → ℝ)) by ext L <;> rfl]
    exact (hasFDerivAt_const κ ℓ).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id ℓ)
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp ℓ hi).fderiv.symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => polygonR2 p.1 p.2)
      (κ, ℓ) :=
  contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun i => contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint i.val hw

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_vertexR2_joint (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => vertexR2 p.1 p.2 j)
      (κ, ℓ) := by
  unfold vertexR2
  apply ContDiffAt.sum
  intro k _
  have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      (p.2 (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)) (κ, ℓ) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (κ, ℓ) (by fun_prop)
  have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
      (heading p.1 p.2 k : ℂ)) (κ, ℓ) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (κ, ℓ) (contDiffAt_heading_joint k hw)
  exact hl.mul ((hh.mul contDiffAt_const).cexp)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.contDiffAt_heading_joint
lean.code:
theorem contDiffAt_heading_joint (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, |κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |κ i * (ℓ i / 2)| < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ r (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => heading p.1 p.2 j)
      (κ, ℓ) := by
  unfold heading
  exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => contDiffAt_turningAngle_joint _ (hw _).1 (hw _).2

blocks.tex:
The maps are finite sums and compositions of coordinate maps,
products, complex exponentials and arcsines. The strict walls keep the
arcsine arguments away from $-1$ and $1$. The chain rule for
$\ell\mapsto(\kappa,\ell)$ identifies the partial derivative.

blocks.label: def:discrete_local_family
blocks.title: A local coherent realization family
blocks.body:
A local family at $\kappa_0$ consists of an open neighborhood
$U\subseteq\RR^n$ containing $\kappa_0$ and a $C^1$ length map
$\ell\colon U\to\RR^n$ such that every $\kappa\in U$ is positive,
$\operatorname{ModerateArc}(0,\kappa,\ell(\kappa))$ holds,
$E(\kappa,\ell(\kappa))=0$, $T(\kappa,\ell(\kappa))=2\pi$,
and the developed polygon is simple. The same developed labelled vertex
tuple depends $C^1$ on $\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily
lean.code:
structure LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily (κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ) where
  neighborhood : Set (ZMod n → ℝ)
  isOpen_neighborhood : IsOpen neighborhood
  base_mem : κ₀ ∈ neighborhood
  lengths : (ZMod n → ℝ) → (ZMod n → ℝ)
  contDiffOn_lengths : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 lengths neighborhood
  positive : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, ∀ i, 0 < κ i
  moderate : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, ModerateArc 0 κ (lengths κ)
  closure : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, closureGap κ (lengths κ) = 0
  fullTurn : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, turningSum κ (lengths κ) = 2 * Real.pi
  simple : ∀ κ ∈ neighborhood, IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ (lengths κ))
  contDiffOn_vertices : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun κ => polygonR2 κ (lengths κ)) neighborhood

namespace LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily

variable {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (S : LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀)

blocks.label: thm:tabachnikov_local_continuity
blocks.title: Local coherent choice at every nonconstant admissible profile
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$ and let $\kappa_0$ satisfy
$\operatorname{DiscreteFourVertexPos}(\kappa_0)$ and be nonconstant.
Then there is a local coherent realization family at $\kappa_0$.
Equivalently, positivity and any strict four-vertex window suffice;
there is no regularity hypothesis on the profile, and adjacent equal
readings are permitted.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.tabachnikovProblem2_local_continuity
lean.code:
theorem tabachnikovProblem2_local_continuity (_hn : 4 ≤ n)
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (hκ₀ : DiscreteFourVertexPos κ₀)
    (hnonconstant : ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, κ₀ i = c) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hc | ⟨c, _, hd⟩⟩ := hκ₀
  · exact (hnonconstant hc).elim
  · exact localContinuousRealization_of_dfv hp hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
lean.code:
theorem RegularFourAnchor.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} (A : RegularFourAnchor κ₀) (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  have hb := A.frame.lengths_nonneg_lt_edgeCap κ₀ A.halfLengths hκ₀
    A.positive A.start_lt A.finish_lt
  have hzero : closureMapR3 (κ₀, A.frame.lengths A.halfLengths) = 0 := by
    unfold closureMapR3
    rw [A.frame.closureGap_eq_controller, A.frame.turningSum_eq_controller, A.zero]
    simp
  have h01 := A.frame.strictMono (show (0 : Fin 4) < 1 by decide)
  have h12 := A.frame.strictMono (show (1 : Fin 4) < 2 by decide)
  have h23 := A.frame.strictMono (show (2 : Fin 4) < 3 by decide)
  have h3n := A.frame.lt_n 3
  exact nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective (by omega)
    hκ₀ hb hzero (A.frame.active_surj_of_controller_regular hκ₀ A.positive hb A.zero A.regular)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
lean.code:
theorem localContinuousRealization_of_dfv
    {κ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i) (hdfv : DFV κ₀ c) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_dfv hκ₀ hdfv
  exact A.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily hκ₀

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective
lean.code:
theorem nonempty_localDiscreteRealizationFamily_of_active_surjective
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ₀ ℓ₀ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hκ₀ : ∀ i, 0 < κ₀ i)
    (hℓ₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ₀ i ∧ ℓ₀ i < edgeCap κ₀ i)
    (hzero : closureMapR3 (κ₀, ℓ₀) = 0)
    (hactive : ∀ y : ℂ × ℝ, ∃ b : ZMod n → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun L => closureMapR3 (κ₀, L)) ℓ₀ b = y ∧
        ∀ i, ℓ₀ i = 0 → b i = 0) :
    Nonempty (LocalDiscreteRealizationFamily κ₀) := by
  let V : Set ((ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ)) :=
    {p | ∀ i, 0 < p.1 i ∧
      |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧ |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)| < 1}
  have hV : IsOpen V := by
    have hVe : V = ⋂ i : ZMod n, {p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) |
      0 < p.1 i ∧ |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)| < 1 ∧
        |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)| < 1} := by ext p; simp [V]
    rw [hVe]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    intro i
    have hk : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) => p.1 i) := by fun_prop
    have hl : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
        |p.1 i * (p.2 (i - 1) / 2)|) := by fun_prop
    have hr : Continuous (fun p : (ZMod n → ℝ) × (ZMod n → ℝ) =>
        |p.1 i * (p.2 i / 2)|) := by fun_prop
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hk).inter
      ((isOpen_lt hl continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hr continuous_const))
  have hw := strict_arc_walls_of_nonneg_lt_edgeCap hκ₀ hℓ₀
  have hpartial := fderiv_closureMapR3_inr hw
  obtain ⟨U, s, hUopen, hU₀, hscd, hgood⟩ :=
    (contDiffAt_closureMapR3_joint (r := 1) hw).exists_localSection_pos_of_active_surjective
      (fun i => (hℓ₀ i).1) (by simpa only [hpartial] using hactive) hV
      (fun i => ⟨hκ₀ i, hw i⟩)
  have hpos : ∀ κ ∈ U, ∀ i, 0 < κ i := fun κ hκ i => (hgood κ hκ).1 i |>.1
  have hmod : ∀ κ ∈ U, ModerateArc 0 κ (s κ) := by
    intro κ hκ
    apply moderateArc_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i
    have hi := (hgood κ hκ).1 i
    have hl := (hgood κ hκ).2.1
    refine ⟨hl i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (half_pos (hl (i - 1)))] using hi.2.1
    · simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (half_pos (hl i))] using hi.2.2
  have heq : ∀ κ ∈ U, closureMapR3 (κ, s κ) = 0 :=
    fun κ hκ => (hgood κ hκ).2.2.trans hzero
  have hclose : ∀ κ ∈ U, closureGap κ (s κ) = 0 :=
    fun κ hκ => congrArg Prod.fst (heq κ hκ)
  have hturn : ∀ κ ∈ U, turningSum κ (s κ) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro κ hκ
    have ht := congrArg Prod.snd (heq κ hκ)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ht
  refine ⟨⟨U, hUopen, hU₀, s, hscd, hpos, hmod, hclose, hturn,
    fun κ hκ => isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn (hmod κ hκ) (hpos κ hκ)
      (hclose κ hκ) (hturn κ hκ), ?_⟩⟩
  intro κ hκ
  exact (contDiffAt_polygonR2_joint (fun i => ((hgood κ hκ).1 i).2)).comp_contDiffWithinAt κ
    (contDiffWithinAt_id.prodMk (hscd κ hκ))

blocks.tex:
The nonconstant hypothesis selects the strict-DFV branch. The anchor
producer from \cref{chap:discrete_four_active} supplies a regular
four-edge anchor $\ell_0$ for this literal profile. The full ambient
controller vanishes at $(\kappa_0,\ell_0)$. Its length derivative is
onto using directions supported on the four positive edges: the
four-coordinate controller and ambient controller differ, at a zero,
by an invertible output scaling and rotation.

Apply \cref{thm:discrete_positive_section} to $G$, taking $V$ to impose
positive curvature and both strict arcsine walls, but not positivity of
lengths. This is open and contains the anchor. The resulting length
section is strictly positive and has $G=0$, so moderate arcs, exact
closure and the real full turn hold for the same section. The existing
positive-turning convexity theorem supplies simplicity. Joint smoothness
of reconstruction and the chain rule give $C^1$ dependence of the vertices.
The combinatorial selection of a frame occurs only at $\kappa_0$;
nearby profiles are treated by this one correction map, even if their
peak orderings or adjacent equalities change.
